name: kukux-digital-signature-agent
description: Desktop signing agent: hardware-backed device keys (Secure Enclave / TPM) for the kukux/digital-signature package.
author: Kukux

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --win
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:native && npm run test:native
scripts.dist:local: NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.free.yml --publish never
